title: アカデミックライティング
subtitle: Academic Writing
keywords: Report making 2.Document quotation 3.Civil and environmental engineering 4.Sentence comprehension
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) understand the essence of civil and environmental engineering. (2) gain skills for producing reports that relate to civil and environmental engineering.
advice: This is a basic course on describing papers. We will cover the following materials: 1. Problem discovery skills 2. Information gathering, analysis, and arrangement skills 3. Problem-solving ability 4. Report writing skills 5. Quotation skills Students are required to actively participate in class. Students are expected to bring their textbook and other necessary materials to every class. These skills are useful in all subjects. Additionally, they are valuable preparation for entrance examinations for graduate school and for preparing resumes and applications when job hunting.
requiredKnowledge: Reading and writing in Japanese. Using library and Internet.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
